description_en: Creates a SQL statement assessment task. You submit SQL statements through this operation, and the system performs static analysis and risk assessment to identify execution risks and compatibility issues on the target database instance
description_zh: 用于创建 SQL 语句评估任务，通过该接口，用户提交 SQL 语句，系统将对其进行静态分析与风险评估，输出其在目标数据库实例上的执行风险、兼容性问题
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx create-sql-evaluate-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-shr4idrgogti89 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSQLEvaluateTask

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html operation to query the regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例所在地域id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of all instances in the target region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标地域下所有实例的详情，包括实例id
parameters.name: db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the target SQL statement
parameters.name: slink_task_desc

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196836.html operation to query the details of all source ApsaraDB RDS instances in the target region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 源rds实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196836.html接口查看目标地域下所有的源rds实例详情，包括实例id
parameters.name: src_res_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. Valid values: enable: enables the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. disabled: disables the source ApsaraDB RDS instance
parameters.help_zh: 源rds实例是否开启源rds，取值范围如下：*enable：开启源rds*disabled：关闭源rds
parameters.name: src_db

parameters.help_en: The username of the source instance
parameters.name: src_user_name

parameters.help_en: The port number of the source instance. Valid values: 3200 to 3999. > This parameter is available and required only when DBEndpointInstanceType is set to polardb-o
parameters.help_zh: 源端口号，取值范围为3200~3999。>当dbendpointinstancetype取值为polardb-o时，本参数才可用且必须传入
parameters.name: src_password

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target SQL statement. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the ID
parameters.help_zh: 目标sql的id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标sql的详情，包括id
parameters.name: dst_res_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance on which the target SQL statement is executed. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 执行目标sql的实例id。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标sql的详情，包括实例id
parameters.name: dst_db

parameters.help_en: The username of the destination instance
parameters.name: dst_user_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the target SQL statement. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the details of the target SQL statement, including the password
parameters.help_zh: 目标sql的密码。>您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看目标sql的详情，包括密码
parameters.name: dst_password

parameters.help_en: The task ID for executing the target SQL statement. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html operation to query the IDs of target SQL statements supported by PolarDB-X
parameters.help_zh: 执行目标sql的任务id。>您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196830.html接口查看polardb-x支持的目标sql的id
parameters.name: slink_task_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the source instance. Valid values: RDS_MYSQL, POLARX1, POLARX2_STANDARD, POLARX2_ENTERPRISE, and POLARDB_M
parameters.name: src_res_type

Message.description_en: The response message. > This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. If the request fails, an exception message is returned, such as an error code
Message.description_zh: 返回消息。>请求成功时该参数为空，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
